title: Software Change Request in AI-Synthesized Software Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.00294v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mobile app stores are a rich source of user feedback containing many change requests, bug reports, improvement suggestions, etc., relevant to the post-deployment modification of software. However, it is challenging to manually translate this free format data to actionable change requests (SCRs). This review presents studies that have applied rule-based techniques, traditional ML approaches, topic modelling, hybrid approaches, and a few deep learning approaches. The data sets used range from small annotated sets to millions of reviews. However, there is inconsistency in the names, availability, annotation guidelines and sampling methods used across different studies. Many studies use Bag-of-Words and TF-IDF, while Na\"ive Bayes, Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees and Random Forest are frequently applied. Precision, Recall and F1-scores are commonly used for evaluation; however, results and experiments are not easily comparable. S

translated_title: 人工智能合成软件演化中的软件变更请求
translated_abstract: 移动应用商店是用户反馈的丰富来源，其中包含大量与软件部署后修改相关的变更请求、缺陷报告、改进建议等。然而，手工将这些自由格式的数据转化为可操作的变更请求（SCR）具有很大挑战。本综述介绍了应用基于规则的技术、传统机器学习方法、主题建模、混合方法以及少量深度学习方法的相关研究。所使用的数据集规模从小的标注集合到数百万条评论不等。然而，不同研究之间在名称、可用性、标注指南和抽样方法方面存在不一致性。许多研究使用词袋模型和TF-IDF，而朴素贝叶斯、支持向量机、决策树和随机森林等方法被频繁采用。精确率、召回率和F1分数是常用的评估指标，但各研究的结果和实验不易相互比较。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了利用规则、传统机器学习、主题建模及深度学习方法从应用商店用户评论中自动提取软件变更请求的研究现状，并指出不同研究在数据集、标注规范和评估指标上缺乏一致性，导致结果难以比较。
en_tdlr: This review surveys studies extracting software change requests from app store user feedback using rule-based, traditional ML, topic modelling, and deep learning approaches, highlighting inconsistencies in datasets, annotation guidelines, and evaluation metrics that hinder comparability across studies.
